mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in non-farm payrolls signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC for the interaction signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts signals weakening consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST declines, or Rank IC for the signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates strengthening supply-side economic activity that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1800 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer spending and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1800, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index falls below 110, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial output, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
